# StudySync

> StudySync connects South African students with verified tutors and an AI-powered StudyMode for curriculum-aligned learning, quizzes, flashcards, and exam prep.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of StudySync — AI study tools, tutor matching, and resource library.
- [Learner Sign Up](/learner/auth): Create a learner account to access StudyMode and book tutors.
- [Become a Tutor](/tutor/auth): Apply to join as a verified tutor on StudySync.

## Optional

- [Payment Success](/payment-success): Post-checkout confirmation page.
- [Payment Cancelled](/payment-cancelled): Cancelled checkout page.
